description: Trigger check for the skills in this repository. Each case is one user message. should_trigger true: one of our skills should load, expected_skill is the best fit and also_ok lists other skills from this repository that are an acceptable first pick. should_trigger false: a realistic near-miss where none of our skills should load. Run with evals/run-triggers.mjs, see evals/README.md.
